environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed with default concurrency settings (unreserved concurrency pool). Lambda execution environment reuses containers across warm invocations. API Gateway endpoint with IAM authorization but tenant_id is passed in request body without server-side validation against the caller's identity. PostgreSQL 14 on RDS with standard role-based access (no RLS policies enabled). The DB_USER has SELECT access to all tenant data. Multiple tenants share the same Lambda function ARN.
